title: Concorde Singapore Airlines / British Airways G-BOAD (Limited Edition of 120, with stand)
notes: Singapore Airlines livery on the left side, British Airways on the right; limited edition of 120 with numbered card; display stand and landing gear included
description: Singapore Airlines had its livery placed on the left side of Concorde G-BOAD under a joint marketing agreement with British Airways. Singapore insignias appeared on the cabin fittings and the airline's "Singapore Girl" stewardesses shared cabin duty with British Airways flight attendants, while flight crew, operations and insurance stayed with British Airways. The arrangement first ran for three flights between 9 and 13 December 1977, resumed on 24 January 1979 and operated until 1 November 1980.
